 Coroner Releases Autopsy Findings in West Lafayette Suspected Murder-Suicide 
 The Tippecanoe County Coroner’s Office Friday released the preliminary autopsy results for members of the Tkach family. (WLFI) By Chris Locken Published : Nov. 20, 2026 at 2:38 PM EST | Updated : 14 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google LAFAYETTE, Ind. (WLFI) - The Tippecanoe County Coroner’s Office Friday released the preliminary autopsy results for members of the Tkach family, who were found dead in a murder-suicide in their West Lafayette home Wednesday evening.
 Julie, Katharyn & Lauren Tkach died from multiple gunshot wounds with their manner of death listed as homicide.
 Thomas Tkach died from a self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head and his manner of death is listed as suicide.
 The toxicology results are pending and may take 6 to 8 weeks.
 The coroner’s office reminds you that if you or someone you know is struggling with mental health, there are resources available. You can call or text 988 to reach the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline.
